AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.

17. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.

19. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

20. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

21. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

22. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Structures in Animal production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Inorganic fertilisers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Water conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetative propagation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
